Tech jobs in the United States

Fortune Jobs AI lists 20,651 open tech jobs across 18 roles in the United States, updated November 25, 2026. Roles in this catalogue include Software Engineer, Business Analyst, and Data Analyst. The states with the most listings are California (2,110), Virginia (1,426), and Texas (1,129). This job portal groups openings by role and location so you can compare listings and check original postings for requirements and application instructions. The table links to indexed state pages when enough listings are available. Counts reflect this catalogue snapshot, not every vacancy in the market.

Frequently asked questions

How many tech jobs are listed?

Fortune Jobs AI lists 20,651 open tech jobs in the United States as of November 25, 2026.

Which roles are covered?

This catalogue includes Software Engineer (6,102), Business Analyst (2,638), Data Analyst (2,107), Data Engineer (1,672), Data Scientist (1,671), DevOps Engineer (1,358), Full Stack Developer (1,208), Machine Learning Engineer (897), QA Engineer (820), Cloud Engineer (684), Salesforce Developer (427), ServiceNow Developer (377), Cybersecurity Analyst (347), Anaplan Model Builder (128), Business Intelligence Developer (91), SQL Developer (71), Tableau Developer (28), and Power BI Developer (25).

Which states have the most listings?

The leading states in this snapshot are California (2,110), Virginia (1,426), Texas (1,129), New York (1,072), and Maryland (905).

Why do some counts have no state-page link?

Links point to existing indexed role/state pages. Tech role/state pages require at least 40 open jobs; other counts still contribute to the category total.

What should I check before applying?

Use the original posting to confirm availability, requirements, pay and application instructions. Fortune Jobs AI is a job portal and does not guarantee a response or hiring outcome.
